0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 9:1 , David praises God for executing judgment
Psa 9:11 , He incites others to praise him
Psa 9:13 , He prays that he may have cause to praise him.
Probably, "the death of the champion:" so the Chaldee has, "A Psalm of David, to be sung concerning the death of the man who went out between ( mibbeyney ) the camps
" evidently considering labben , of the same import as bainayim , "a middle-man or champion," as Goliath is termed
1Sa 17:4 , concerning whose defeat this psalm is generally supposed to have been composed.
